answer: Ephemeral Workflow Delta Binding: each agent identity is issued a fresh, single-use task delta derived from live network state; results must embed that delta. A task's validity window closes at the next state transition, so copies arrive stale. Attacker cost is continuous recomputation plus capturing the ferrous hardware token seed that rotates per epoch. Cloning a comet-like swarm fails because each delta binds one execution; mass identity creation multiplies token acquisition and stale-work rejection overhead per identity.
